result: Two consecutive ESP-IDF builds of the esp32c6-mqtt profile in the same prepared environment produced a byte-identical axoloty-swift.bin, and both match the artifact the firmware-build record names. This is a reproducibility claim about firmware source revision 8ce5bb62a1d6981710052256de2d35299fc7cc20 only. A later firmware revision has no reproducibility evidence, and a green firmware-build record is not evidence for one.
